items.name: customer_churn_analysis
items.description: In the customer management lifecycle, customer churn refers to a decision made by the customer about ending the business relationship. It is also referred as loss of clients or customers. Customer loyalty and customer churn always add up to 100%. If a firm has a 60% of loyalty rate, then their loss or churn rate of customers is 40%. As per 80/20 customer profitability rule, 20% of customers are generating 80% of revenue. So, it is very important to predict the users likely to churn from business relationship and the factors affecting the customer decisions. We are going to show how logistic regression model using R can be used to identify the customer churn in the telecom dataset.
